dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You think love makes you better than me?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting)

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Enraged Scream)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Enough!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Hateful, Malicious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping)

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic)

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Agonized)

dialogue_segments.text: No!

dialogue_segments.text: One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash.
